zh-CN.title: 年末来信
items: 空间开启年度回顾后，可在菜单里拆开年末来信，回看这一年的聊天点滴。
获授权的空间可换上「平安夜小镇」主题，看看飘雪、圣诞树和送礼物的圣诞老人。
普通群聊支持主动加入多人语音，永久 VIP 的私聊与群聊共享每周 30 分钟，群聊按个人参会时长扣除额度。
群聊也可以在聊天快捷操作里添加通话按钮。
圣诞装饰融入各页标题和弹层，广场与菜单采用统一的提醒圆点。

en.title: A year-end letter
items: Once your space opens its annual recap, open your year-end letter from the menu and revisit a year of conversations.
Spaces with access can switch to Christmas Eve, with a snowy village, a decorated tree, and Santa delivering gifts.
Join group voice calls from chat. Permanent VIPs share 30 minutes a week across direct and group calls, with group time counted per person.
Add Call to your group chat shortcuts.
Christmas details now trim page headers and dialogs, and Square and Menu share the same notification dot.
